product_one_liner.value: SMS-Magic is a multichannel business messaging platform that helps sales, marketing, and service teams communicate with prospects and customers through SMS, WhatsApp, and other messaging channels.
product_one_liner.notes: The product overview describes multichannel business messaging and explicitly identifies sales and marketing representatives and service agents as target users: https://www.sms-magic.co/docs/salesforce/knowledge-base/overview-2.

pricing_page.notes: SMS-Magic has a public pricing page: https://pricing.sms-magic.com/.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Upstart has a dedicated customer case study at https://www.sms-magic.com/case-studies/upstart. The customer case-study index names Ochre Recruitment using SMS-Magic: https://www.sms-magic.com/sms-resources/sms-case-studies. | named_customers.0: Upstart is the subject of a customer case study: https://www.sms-magic.com/case-studies/upstart. | named_customers.1: The customer case-study index identifies Ochre Recruitment using SMS-Magic: https://www.sms-magic.com/sms-resources/sms-case-studies.

employee_band.notes: The official careers page states that SMS-Magic has 200+ employees in India plus employees in Europe and the United States: https://www.sms-magic.com/sms-jobs. A company directory explicitly gives 201–500: http://prospeo.io/c/sms-magic-email-format. A conflicting LinkedIn size range reduces confidence.

founded_year.notes: The company profile explicitly lists Founded 2008: https://linkedin.com/company/1110444.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index contains messaging use cases, compliance guidance, campaigns, and product-selection articles, not two engineer-authored accounts of building the product: https://www.sms-magic.com/blog.

public_docs.notes: The public technical resource center provides multiple documentation collections, including Converse Quickstart and the Salesforce User Guide: https://www.sms-magic.com/docs.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable open-role lists contain no qualifying AI, ML, data-science, NLP, LLM, or computer-vision title: https://huntyourtribe.com/jobs/companies/sms-magic and https://www.nextknock.in/companies/sms-magic. The latter provides a November 6, 2026 freshness signal. Confidence is reduced because these are third-party job indexes.

model_provider.notes: The product documentation explicitly describes Open AI integration using an API key and, where applicable, an Assistant ID: https://docs.sms-magic.com/rX9XdO2FY0Q-sms-magic-converse-salesforce-app/6ReFmf74mPA-faq-bot. This establishes supported OpenAI use, not an exclusive provider or a specific model version.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The compliance page names ISO 27001 under security standards and HIPAA and GDPR under compliance: https://trust.sms-magic.com/compliance-and-certification.
